info.title: Email Sender API — Google AI Studio Integration
info.description: Give this file to Google AI Studio as a reference. Set the system_instructions below, add the function_declaration as a Tool, and use your service_api_key in every send_email call.
info.auth: X-Api-Key header  OR  apiKey field in the JSON body

system_instructions: You are an email assistant. When the user asks you to send an email, call the send_email function. Always confirm the recipient, subject and body before sending unless the user has already provided them. After a successful send, confirm to the user that the email was sent.

service_config._note: Fill in your values. Never commit real keys to source control.

function_declaration.name: send_email
function_declaration.description: Send an email to one or more recipients using the configured email service. The email is dispatched from the service configured sender address and SMTP server.

recipients.description: List of recipient email addresses. Example: ["alice@example.com"]

body.description: Body content of the email. Can be plain text or HTML.

isHtml.description: Set true if body contains HTML markup. Defaults to true.

body.subject: Hello from AI Studio
body.body: This email was sent by an AI assistant.

error_responses.400: Subject and Body are required  /  At least one recipient is required
error_responses.500: SMTP error — check service SMTP settings
